articles.title: Riyadh airport attack another dangerous moment in already tense conflict
articles.description: The Houthis have stepped up their attacks on Saudi Arabian soil, and while the physical damage can be quickly repaired, its reputation for stability is taking a battering.

articles.title: Buildings swept away as flash floods hit central Nepal
articles.description: A flash flood at the Budhi Gandaki River has swept away several buildings and bridges, two months after catastrophic floods hit the country.

articles.title: Wildlife park remains closed after fatal tiger attack
articles.description: Yorkshire Wildlife Park remains closed after a man entered the tiger enclosure and was fatally attacked on Saturday.

articles.title: UK does not support Trump's Russia diesel deal, says Streeting
articles.description: The defence secretary says the US and its allies need to increase pressure on Vladimir Putin to end the war with Ukraine.
